about: Published reports that CUT&Tag, CUT&RUN or related bead-based chromatin profiling was run on a liquid handler or device (#154). Each entry: the platform as the source names it, the catalogue handler it maps to (match 'same' = that model; 'related' = same maker's earlier or unstated model, e.g. Biomek FX for the Biomek i7), the assay, the source with a verbatim quote. Collected 6 Nov 2026 from PMC/Europe PMC full text, protocols.io, a core-facility sheet and a vendor release. Evidence only: never a capability, fact or ranking input. Other tagmentation variants (ACT-seq, CUTAC, sci-CUT&Tag): no automated report found on any platform.

items.automated: Washes, pA-MNase tethering, MNase digestion at 0-4 C (aluminium block on a cooling unit), release; pre- and post-PCR Ampure XP cleanups on the robot. ConA bead binding, permeabilisation and primary antibody done by hand first; end-polishing, ligation and PCR on a separate thermocycler. Alpaqua 96S Super Magnet Plate.
